basis_statement: Local startup is deterministic: base services first, idempotent bootstrap helpers second, deterministic seed loading third, semantic smoke fourth, and only then may host processes start.

phases.label: Base services
notes: Only the substrate services come up here; no host process may assume semantic readiness yet.

phases.label: Schema and namespace bootstrap
notes: Bootstrap helpers are one-shot and idempotent. They create databases, buckets, queue namespaces, and cache sentinels without opening host processes.

phases.label: Deterministic seeding
notes: Seed loading imports only the governed synthetic fixture pack and the reviewed deterministic golden-pack basis.

phases.label: Semantic smoke and validation
notes: The smoke phase proves northbound receipt, queue, object-store, cache, and audit foundations while running authoritative validators by default.

phases.label: Host processes
notes: Host processes remain outside compose for faster edit cycles, but they are still gated on semantic readiness.
